heading: Customized map view for enhanced delivery task management and efficient route prioritization.

blocks.html: I also customized the map view to align with the task list view, providing a comprehensive package distribution map to help drivers manage tasks more effectively. Deliveries in a local area can be easily tracked and filtered through the map view. Keeping consistency with the list view makes it easier for drivers to switch between the two view modes. The visual representation of geographic areas enables drivers to efficiently prioritize deliveries.
